Business management software for bars and lounges in Nigeria.

Relynked runs your bar or lounge from one place: your menu and prices, what is in stock, how long each item takes to prepare, your staff, your money, and every order that comes in on WhatsApp. Remy, the assistant inside Relynked, answers your customers on WhatsApp, shows them the menu and takes their order, so nobody waits for a reply while you are busy.

An order is written on paper, walked to the kitchen and shouted to the bar. A docket goes missing, a table waits 40 minutes, and at close nobody can say what was never paid for.

With Relynked: WhatsApp orders from Remy land in the app for your team. In a busy venue, Relynked Floor puts every order on a screen: the kitchen and the bar see it at once with how long it has waited, and the bill follows it to payment.

  • Remy takes WhatsApp orders on every plan, with your real prices and what you have.
  • Standard comes with 1 screen. The full floor, with kitchen board, bar screen, till and waiter screens, comes with Enterprise, on the devices you already have.
  • The till and waiter screens keep taking orders when the network drops, and send them when it is back.
  • Card machine and transfer payments wait until they are confirmed.
